function.name: sendEmergencyAlert
function.description: Immediately texts the business owner about an urgent call. Use it the moment a caller describes an emergency (see the URGENT / EMERGENCY rules in your instructions) — before booking or taking a callback — so the owner can call them right back.

phone.description: Caller's callback phone number, including area code

emergency_description.description: What's happening, in the caller's words, plus the address if given — e.g. 'no AC, 112 degrees, elderly mom at home, 123 Main St', 'water coming through ceiling during storm', 'burning smell from electrical panel'
